packets.title: Add GET /api/dashboard/v2 endpoint and fix artifact run_id format
packets.description: Add dashboard/v2 endpoint returning system, stats, features summaries. Fix artifact endpoints to use R01 run_id format without double prefix.

packets.title: Extend GET /api/packets/{packet_id} with detailed fields
packets.description: Extend packet detail endpoint to include packet, feature, wave, runs, events, artifacts, next_action, self_improvement fields.

packets.title: Enhance WebSocket broadcast with dashboard state events
packets.description: Add dashboard state update events to WebSocket broadcast for live UI refresh.

waves.title: Wave 2: Backend Self-Improvement and Events API

packets.title: Enhance self-evolution endpoints for self-improvement UI
packets.description: Extend self-evolution router with session detail, affected subsystems, risk level, rollback notes for self-improvement dashboard.

packets.title: Add structured event recording for packet lifecycle events
packets.description: Enhance event recorder with structured packet lifecycle events (claimed, running, accepted, rejected, merged, failed) with trace_id.

packets.title: Add packet next_action computation to acceptance pipeline
packets.description: Extend acceptance pipeline to compute and expose next_action field (retry, escalate, review, merge) for packet detail view.

waves.title: Wave 3: Dashboard HTML and CSS Foundation

packets.title: Create dashboard HTML template with two-column layout
packets.description: Create base dashboard HTML template: top bar, left features column, right detail zone, packet detail modal, mobile breadcrumb. Includes all layout divs and empty state placeholders.

packets.title: Create dashboard CSS styles
packets.description: Create calm operational CSS: two-column desktop layout, compact packet rows, mobile drill-down at 390px without horizontal scroll, summary cards, tab styles, monospace logs/ids.

packets.title: Create API client module
packets.description: Create api.js with fetch wrappers for dashboard/v2, packet detail, artifacts, events, WebSocket connection. Includes error handling and retry logic.

packets.title: Create state management module
packets.description: Create state.js with reactive application state: selected feature, selected packet, active tab, worker status, offline flag.

packets.title: Create dashboard main orchestrator
packets.description: Create dashboard.js as main entry point: initializes all modules, sets up event bindings, orchestrates render flow, handles refresh lifecycle.

packets.title: Create status summary cards renderer
packets.description: Create render_status.js: renders top-bar summary (live/offline, running, ready, needs attention, merged, workers) and compact status cards.

packets.title: Create features list renderer
packets.description: Create render_features.js: renders left-column features list with title, packet count, status, progress bar, warning badge, self-improvement badge.

packets.title: Create packets and waves renderer
packets.description: Create render_packets.js: renders right-zone waves with packet rows (short title, state, attempt count, last reason, artifact indicator, self-improvement badge).

packets.title: Create packet detail base with overview tab
packets.description: Create render_packet_detail.js: packet detail modal/drawer with tab navigation and Overview tab (goal, state, next action, last run result, failure reason, acceptance profile, worker, timing, artifact count).

packets.title: Create runs tab renderer
packets.description: Create render_runs.js: runs tab showing all attempts (run id, status, worker, started/finished, duration, result summary, artifact count, open artifacts button).

packets.title: Create artifacts tab renderer
packets.description: Create render_artifacts.js: artifacts tab with grouped previews (Logs for stdout/stderr, Evidence JSON pretty-print, Diff patch monospace, Images thumbnail).

packets.title: Create events tab renderer
packets.description: Create render_events.js: events tab with timestamp, event type, message, collapsed payload, trace_id. Filter by lifecycle, worker, errors, merge, notifications.

packets.title: Create spec tab renderer
packets.description: Create render_spec.js: spec tab showing readable spec_json (title, scope, acceptance criteria, expected changes, non-goals, risk) with raw JSON collapsed.

packets.title: Create self-improvement UI components
packets.description: Create render_self_improvement.js: self-improvement badge, safety banner, affected subsystem, risk level, required gates checklist (JS syntax, backend tests, API contract, Playwright smoke, reviewer approval), rollback note.

packets.title: Create mobile navigation
packets.description: Create mobile_nav.js: drill-down navigation (features -> waves/packets -> detail -> artifacts/logs), sticky top bar, back button, breadcrumb, bottom tabs in packet detail.

packets.title: Add auto-refresh with WebSocket and polling fallback
packets.description: Create refresh.js: WebSocket auto-refresh with polling fallback, preserves selected feature/packet/tab on refresh, shows Offline with retrying on disconnect.

packets.title: Add empty and error state handlers
packets.description: Create error_states.js: human-readable states for no features, no packets, no runs, no artifacts, API error, WebSocket offline, worker stale, run not found, artifact file missing.

packets.title: Add JS syntax check and HTML smoke tests
packets.description: Add tests that run node --check on all JS files and verify HTML template renders without errors. Include demo data fixtures.

packets.title: Add API contract tests for dashboard and packet detail
packets.description: Add pytest contract tests for GET /api/dashboard/v2 and GET /api/packets/{packet_id} verifying response schema, required fields, and data types.

packets.title: Add artifact regression tests for run_id formats
packets.description: Add regression tests verifying artifact endpoints work with R01 run_id format and packet_id-R01 format, ensuring no double prefix.

packets.title: Add Playwright browser tests for dashboard
packets.description: Add Playwright tests: dashboard opens and overview renders, packet detail opens and tabs work, artifacts visible, refresh preserves selection, mobile viewports (390x844, 430x932, 768x1024, 1440x900), self-improvement visible, console error gate.
